entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi... yes. I... I have a jersey I ordered, and I think I need to return it. I'm a bit lost on how to do it.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you happen to have your order number?
Umm, I think so. Let me find the email... okay, here. It's VF-774-0192.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero Race Jersey, which was delivered about 39 days ago. To understand the best way to help, is it a technical fault with the jersey or more of a preference issue?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's just the wrong size. It's way too tight across the chest. I was hoping I could do an exchange, maybe? I looked on the website but the instructions were confusing. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I'd be happy to clarify the process for you. One moment while I review the policy for your item... Okay, I have good news. Your jersey is a standard item, and you're well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, 90 days? That's great! I was so worried I had missed the deadline. So I can send it back?

Absolutely. I've just authorized the return in our system. I'm sending you an email right now that will contain a prepaid shipping label and a link to start the exchange for the correct size if you'd prefer that.
That's such a relief. Thank you so much, Diana. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
